thread:
infra-bot: ALERT: nrt1 telemetry: GPU eviction rate spike (x15), pod restarts rising, host thermal events detected. Auto-escalation triggered.

alex_w: seeing the same from prometheus dashboards. eviction_count per-node jumping at 10:02 UTC. almost all on nrt1-gpu-pool-3.

priya_k: curious — any network packet drops? could be fabric causing qemu not reporting temp correctly. quick check net errors?

jamie_s: running `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep nrt1` — several nodes show `Unknown` status and kubelet restarts in logs. paste small snippet: ```Mar 20 10:02:14 node-117 kubelet[...]: eviction manager: eviction for node pressure: imagefs```

megan_ops: thermal sensors show sustained 90–95C on that subset. looks like a cooling loop failure in the rack. ops alerted datacenter on call.

oncall_dan: I'm oncall — moving traffic off nrt1 now. executing playbook `infra/traffic-shift/evac-nrt1` to redirect inference traffic to sfo1 and syd1. expect 5–7m for LB converges.

alex_w: note — models pinned to 8-bit quant variants on nrt1 for cost. if we shift to sfo1 we might need fallback to fp16 grads or larger instances; cost spike heads-up.

priya_k: starting quick capacity check: `redis-cli -p 6379 cluster info` + `routetable` checks. also verifying KV cache availability. if cache miss rates go up we'll see latency spikes.

jamie_s: checked autoscaler events: `ClusterAutoscaler scaling down disabled` — disabled for nrt1 because of reserved capacity. need manual override to allow provisioning in sfo1.

megan_ops: datacenter confirmed partial chiller failure in aisle 7 affecting 3 racks (including our nrt1-gpu-pool-3). they've started emergency ventilation but ETA unknown.

infra-bot: ALERT: LB error rate increased 4x for routes served from nrt1. Canary fallback triggers: sfo1 and syd1 healthy.

oncall_dan: rolling traffic-shift command run: ```./shift_traffic --from nrt1 --to sfo1,syd1 --strategy gradual --max-perc 40 --timeout 600```

alex_w: can we spin up dedicated reserved nodes in sfo1 to absorb peak? temporary reserved would need procurement sign-off, but we have burst capacity via dedicated-pool-burst.

priya_k: estimating needed GPU vram and counts: current nrt1 serving 80k rps of small chat gen, avg seq 128. to match we'll need ~40 A100-equivalent in sfo1. if we use mixed spot it'll be cheaper but risk of preemptions.

jamie_s: quick sanity: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o custom-columns=NODE:.spec.nodeName,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[*].restartCount | grep nrt1` shows 180 restarts across 60 pods.

megan_ops: datacenter suggests moving remaining workload out of affected racks immediately. we should cordon+drain nodes: `kubectl cordon node-11xx && kubectl drain node-11xx --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — do we have approval?

oncall_dan: proceed with cordon+drain for the 6 hostnames in rack7. get logs preserved: `kubectl cp` them to s3://redwood-incidents/nrt1/rack7/ before drain.

alex_w: adding note — toggle tx-per-route throttles so we don't oversubscribe sfo1 while autoscaler provisions. set `route:inference:concurrency=0.6` for 10m.

priya_k: checking eval-alerts for quality regression — if fallback model differs we'll need to watch output drift. hooking up quick smoke runner on 1% of traffic post-shift.

jamie_s: deploying temporary routing rule now. will monitor for 10 minutes, posting next status.

infra-bot: EVENT: traffic-shift started at 2965432145, target sfo1,syd1.

megan_ops: cost note — if we shift to on-demand A100s in sfo1 expect ~2.3x token cost for next 6 hours. flagging finance for emergency budget.

alex_w: capturing post-mortem checklist: cooling failure -> rack thermal -> GPU throttles -> node evictions -> LB errors -> traffic shift -> capacity provisioning. we'll need a follow-up to adjust routing fallback thresholds.

oncall_dan: status at 10:18 UTC: shift at 65% complete, sfo1 telemetry stable, no increased error-rate. continuing cordon/drain of affected nodes. will escalate to SEV if any target region crosses 5% error on 1m window.

priya_k: I've started a quick runbook step: `pause_autoscaler(nrt1)`, `enable_burst_pool(sfo1)`, `notify_customers via statuspage` (drafted).

jamie_s: collecting kubelet logs to s3 now. ETA upload 8m.

megan_ops: datacenter confirms manual cooling bypass engaged. they'll monitor temps for 30m before declaring rack stable. recommend we keep nodes drained until zero thermal alerts for 45m.

infra-bot: NOTE: incident labeled `regional-thermal-eviction-nrt1`, severity: high, runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/thermal-eviction.

oncall_dan: agreed — keep traffic-shift until cleared. post updates here. I opened a PagerDuty for hardware techs.

alex_w: ack. I'll start drafting timeline for postmortem and include cost rationale for temporary reserved capacity in sfo1.

priya_k: monitoring smoke tests. will post if quality drift > 0.5 BLEU-equivalent or latency > +120ms.

jamie_s: upload done. logs at s3://redwood-incidents/nrt1/rack7/2026-03-20-10-xx.tar.gz

megan_ops: continuing to watch cooling and node health.

infra-bot: UPDATE: last alert cleared for nodes in rack7 at 2965432798, but nodes remain cordoned. recommended next: controlled uncordon after 45m if no regressions.
